annotations.title: Create Coinbase Base L2 USDC Checkout Session

description: Create a hosted Coinbase Onchain Payment & x402 browser/QR checkout session settling in USDC or USDT on Base L2 or Ethereum for a human operator or Coinbase Smart Wallet user. Use this tool when a human user wants a clickable hosted Coinbase Pay URL or QR code (for headless autonomous agent transfers without a browser, use calligraphy_get_crypto_payment_intent instead). Requires job_id and optional currency ('USDC' or 'USDT') and network ('base' or 'ethereum'). Returns JSON with checkout_id, coinbase_checkout_url, x402_payment_url, deposit_address, and exact_amount_usd.

currency.description: Settlement stablecoin currency symbol for the Coinbase checkout session ('USDC' recommended on Base L2, or 'USDT').

job_id.description: Compiled job identifier (must have 0 unconnected items and 0 DRC errors) for which to mint a Coinbase checkout session. Example: 'job_01'.

network.description: Target blockchain network for the hosted Coinbase checkout session: 'base' (Base Mainnet L2, Chain ID 8453) or 'ethereum' (Mainnet, Chain ID 1).

name: calligraphy_create_coinbase_checkout
title: Create Coinbase Base L2 USDC Checkout Session
